message:
The other day, I found myself in a bit of a tizzy as I was packing a go-bag for my family. You know, the kind that you hope you never have to use but feel a bit better having ready. I decided to start a family group chat to gather everyone’s input on what to include. 

To my surprise, the conversation quickly turned into a mix of practical suggestions and lighthearted banter. My granddaughter suggested we pack her favorite stuffed animal, and my son joked about including snacks for the ‘journey’—because who doesn’t need a treat during a crisis? 

In the midst of it all, I realized that preparedness doesn’t have to be heavy or stressful. It can be a bonding experience, bringing us together to think ahead while sharing a laugh. Have you had a similar moment with your family?
